Meeting Minutes: GDPR Strategy & Sovereign Infrastructure Legal Review
Date: February 11, 2026 Participants: Geoffrey, Frédéric Deverre
________________


Executive Summary
The meeting established a definitive legal and technical roadmap for Metadatapp concerning GDPR compliance and international data sovereignty. The primary strategic outcome is for Metadatapp to act as the Data Controller for all data processed within the platform—including customer data and newly generated metadata—to ensure the highest level of legal security. To mitigate risks associated with the US Cloud Act, the team adopted a "total wall" infrastructure strategy, duplicating the application into entirely independent European and US instances with zero data interconnection.
________________


1. GDPR Compliance & Data Governance
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * Legal Status: Metadatapp will operate as the Data Controller (Responsable de traitement) for all managed data, encompassing both original customer data and value-added data created by the platform.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * Operational Principles: The platform must strictly adhere to lawfulness, fairness, transparency, purpose limitation, and data minimization (collecting only necessary data).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * Data Retention & Logging:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * Retention Period: Logging data must be stored for a minimum of 6 months and a maximum of 1 year.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * Automated Deletion: The system must implement automated data deletion, anonymization, IP masking, or identifier removal after the retention window.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * CNIL Recommendations: Limit logs to timestamps, comments, and truncated IPs where technically feasible.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * Transparency: Customers must be fully informed regarding the specific types of data used and their intended purposes.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * Scope Note: Animal research data is confirmed to be outside the scope of GDPR.
2. Infrastructure Sovereignty: "Total Wall" Strategy
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * Cloud Act Risk: Because the US Cloud Act allows American authorities to access data for national security purposes, hosting European data with US-linked providers is considered high-risk.        
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * European Sovereign Hosting: Use of a European sovereign host is critical to ensure data protection remains under EU jurisdiction.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * Secnumcloud Certification: Hosting on a Secnumcloud-certified provider is the recommended solution to guarantee immunity from the Cloud Act in Europe.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * Segmented Environments: The application architecture will be doubled to create two distinct zones:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * European Instance: Hosted on Secnumcloud infrastructure for total security.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * US Instance: Hosted locally in the US to comply with the Cloud Act for the American market.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * Zero Interconnection: A "total wall" will be maintained between these instances, with absolutely no data transfer permitted between continents.
3. Strategic Commercial Value
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * Sales Argument: The guarantee that data remains under European jurisdiction and immune to US executive reach is a major selling point for institutional and pharmaceutical clients.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * Reassurance: By assuming the role of Data Controller and preventing trans-Atlantic data flows, Metadatapp reassures clients that they will not be held responsible for Cloud Act-related data compromises.
________________


Action Items
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * [ ] Legal Review: Consult with the lawyer regarding the specific management of operator data.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * [ ] Architecture Design: Formalize the technical requirements for the "total wall" dual-deployment strategy.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * [ ] Compliance Engineering: Begin developing automated IP truncation and data anonymization protocols for the logging system.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * [ ] Pitch Refinement: Integrate Secnumcloud certification and infrastructure sovereignty as key security differentiators in the commercial deck.
________________


Compte-rendu de réunion : Stratégie RGPD et revue juridique de l'infrastructure souveraine
Date : 11 février 2026
Participants : Geoffrey, Frédéric Deverre
________________


Résumé exécutif
La réunion a permis de définir une feuille de route juridique et technique préliminaire pour Metadatapp concernant la conformité au RGPD et la souveraineté internationale des données. Le principal résultat stratégique est que Metadatapp agira en tant que Responsable de traitement pour l'ensemble des données gérées au sein de la plateforme — incluant les données clients et les métadonnées nouvellement générées — afin de garantir une sécurité juridique maximale. Pour pallier les risques liés au Cloud Act américain, on propose d’adopter une stratégie d'infrastructure en « mur total » (total wall), dupliquant l'application en deux instances indépendantes (Europe et États-Unis) sans aucune interconnexion de données.
________________


1. Conformité RGPD et gouvernance des données
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * Statut juridique : Metadatapp opérera en tant que Responsable de traitement pour toutes les données gérées, englobant les données originales des clients ainsi que les données à valeur ajoutée créées par la plateforme.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * Principes opérationnels : La plateforme doit respecter strictement les principes de licéité, de loyauté, de transparence, de limitation des finalités et de minimisation des données (collecter uniquement les données nécessaires).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * Conservation et journalisation des données :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * Durée de conservation : Les données de journalisation (logs) doivent être conservées pendant une durée comprise entre 6 mois minimum et 1 an maximum.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * Suppression automatisée : Le système doit mettre en œuvre la suppression, l'anonymisation, le masquage d'IP ou la suppression d'identifiants de manière automatique après la période de conservation.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * Recommandations de la CNIL : Limiter les journaux à l'horodatage, aux commentaires et aux adresses IP tronquées lorsque cela est techniquement possible.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * Transparence : Les clients doivent être pleinement informés du type de données utilisées et des buts précis de leur utilisation.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * Note sur le champ d'application : Il est confirmé que les données de recherche animale ne rentrent pas dans le champ d'application du RGPD.
2. Souveraineté de l'infrastructure : Stratégie du « mur total »
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * Risque lié au Cloud Act : Le Cloud Act américain permettant aux autorités américaines d'accéder aux données pour des raisons de sécurité nationale, l'hébergement de données européennes chez des prestataires liés aux États-Unis est considéré comme à haut risque.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * Hébergement souverain européen : L'utilisation d'un hébergeur souverain européen est cruciale pour garantir que la protection des données reste sous juridiction de l'UE.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * Certification Secnumcloud : L'hébergement chez un prestataire certifié Secnumcloud est la solution recommandée pour garantir l'immunité face au Cloud Act en Europe.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * Environnements segmentés : L'architecture applicative sera doublée pour créer deux zones distinctes :
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * Instance européenne : Hébergée sur une infrastructure Secnumcloud pour une sécurité totale.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * Instance US : Hébergée localement aux États-Unis pour se conformer au Cloud Act sur le marché américain.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * Zéro interconnexion : Un « mur total » sera maintenu entre ces instances, avec une interdiction absolue de transfert de données entre les deux continents.
3. Valeur commerciale stratégique
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * Argument de vente : La garantie que les données restent sous juridiction européenne et à l'abri des prérogatives de l'exécutif américain est un argument de vente majeur pour les clients institutionnels et pharmaceutiques.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * Rassurance : En assumant le rôle de Responsable de traitement et en empêchant les flux de données transatlantiques, Metadatapp rassure ses clients sur le fait qu'ils ne seront pas tenus responsables de compromissions de données liées au Cloud Act.
________________


Actions à mener
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * [ ] Revue juridique : Consulter l'avocate concernant la gestion spécifique des données opérateurs.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * [ ] Conception de l'architecture : Formaliser les exigences techniques pour la stratégie de double déploiement en « mur total ».
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * [ ] Ingénierie de conformité : Débuter le développement des protocoles de tronquage d'IP et d'anonymisation automatique pour le système de journalisation.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  * [ ] Affinement du Pitch : Intégrer la certification Secnumcloud et la souveraineté de l'infrastructure comme différenciateurs de sécurité clés dans le support commercial.


Loïs Clementz
Loïs Clementz

BP collective review – 28/01/2026
Revue BP – Metadatapp
Réunion du 28/01/2026
Participants :
 Racym Boutedja (BTD Consulting), Arnaud Marchant & Anthony Hervé (Jubea), Pierre-Chris Tonnon (Catea), Rémi & Anne (Initium), Alice Fontaine, + toi.
1. Objectif de la revue
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           * Challenger le BP sur les aspects techniques ↔ financiers et la stratégie de financement
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           * Identifier des axes de travail ouvrant potentiellement sur des ateliers dédiés
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           * Clarifier ce que l’on veut financer, comment et quand
2. Financements – Constats et Options
2.1 Cycle bancaire & non dilutif
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           * Le bancaire n’intervient qu’après traction commerciale constatée

BP review - Rémi Przybylski
Revue BP - Rémi Przybylski


19/01/2029


Review approach
The BP was reviewed page by page as a management and steering tool, not as a final “investor-ready” document. The focus was on overall coherence, assumptions, and structure, rather than detailed financial validation (which will be done later for Crealia/banks). The financial and narrative BPs were reviewed separately, with the expectation that each should be understandable on its own.
________________


Overall assessment
The BP is significantly more mature than the late-2025 version and shows an unusually high level of reflection for the current development stage. The structure, market vision, sales plan effort, and cash-flow modeling are strong points. The inclusion of payment terms, roadmap, and explicit assumptions is a major strength.
However, several structural weaknesses could raise concerns for financial reviewers:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             * Human resources (especially business development) appear underestimated relative to the projected revenue and MVP maturity.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             * The BP tends to mask uncertainties rather than explicitly highlighting them, whereas early BPs should surface risks to build a realistic financing strategy.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             * Cash flow appears too comfortable for an R&D-heavy project of this scale, making it harder to identify critical stress points.

________________


Key cross-cutting recommendations
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                * Move the roadmap and core assumptions to the beginning of the BP to guide interpretation of the numbers.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                * Explicitly detail assumptions that are currently implicit in tables:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   * Sales model (including recurring revenues),

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   * SaaS positioning,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   * B2B sales cycles by customer type,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   * Adoption timelines (e.g. pharma decision cycles),

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   * Willingness to pay, supported by market feedback.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      * Shift cash-flow modeling from quarterly to monthly to better anticipate financing gaps and decision points.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      * Build a simple executive dashboard (cash, clients, objectives, payments, key operational KPIs) connected to the detailed BP.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      * Create an early adopters group to validate assumptions, de-risk time-to-market (TTM), and strengthen credibility with evaluators.

________________


Section-specific feedback
1. TAM / SAM / SOM
 Ambitious and mature, but not the priority at this stage. Evaluators will be more reassured by a clear market entry strategy: who buys, why, when, and with which perceived risks. The ambition is strong, but evidence and execution logic are missing.
2. Sales Plan
 Considered overly optimistic and insufficiently challenged. It lacks a realistic representation of B2B decision and adoption cycles (interest → POC → first contract → scale-up). This is a major credibility risk.
3. P&L
 Globally solid, but HR costs—especially sales, marketing, and R&D velocity—are likely underestimated. The P&L should be used primarily to identify cost drivers and constraints, not predict profitability.
4. Cash Flow
 The most critical weakness. The presentation does not function well as a decision-making tool:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         * Financing gaps are unclear,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         * Heavy reliance on public funding is risky (earmarked expenses, delayed payments),

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         * Assumptions on loans (amounts, grace periods) appear optimistic,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         * Subsidy disbursement timing is incorrect (partial upfront payment only),

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         * BFR is not clearly identified.
A more conservative and transparent approach is strongly recommended.

5. Roadmap
 Technically clear, but too short-term for a 3-year BP. Commercial acceleration post-MVP (after 2026) should be more explicit and quantified (clients, events, outreach). Dependencies between milestones should be clearer.
6. Financing Plan
 A dedicated, consolidated financing plan tab (grants, loans, fundraising) is missing and should be added.
________________


Conclusion
The BP demonstrates strong maturity and strategic thinking, but its credibility depends on better alignment between sales ambition, HR capacity, R&D timing, and cash reality. Making uncertainties explicit and reinforcing proof points (early adopters, adoption cycles, realistic financing gaps) will significantly strengthen its value as both a steering tool and a financing support document.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * FDA is working on confidence-building frameworks for AI outputs (since AI is not rule-based).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * Goal: allow users to demonstrate integration of AI outputs in regulatory submissions.
Action
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * Write to Clive to initiate membership.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * Clive to introduce Metadatapp to the relevant contact (name uncertain: Eghan Faletch?).
Links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * https://3rc.org/ai/
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * https://3rc.org/membership/

3. Regulatory Acceptance of Virtual Control Groups (VCGs)
Key Question
Would toxicologists and regulators accept Virtual Control Groups derived from historical data, assuming full metadata traceability, or are they only interested in in vitro replacements?
Clive’s View
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * Regulators and toxicologists are absolutely interested.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * Core requirement: evidence that outputs are reliable.
What Regulators Look For
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * Biological relevance:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * Strengths and weaknesses of existing tests.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * Strengths and weaknesses of the proposed approach.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * Relationship to human biology.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * Understanding of mechanisms and components.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * Technical qualities:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * Reliability
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * Reproducibility
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * Robustness
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * Same criteria apply to biological and computational approaches.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * If the information exists, it should be embedded in the submission documentation.
Example: NIH OPERA / CompTox
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * Large historical datasets aggregated and curated.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * Computational models used to:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * Predict rodent oral toxicity.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * Demonstrate better predictive power than traditional tests.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * From a legislative standpoint: very strong case.
Reference
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * https://ntp.niehs.nih.gov/whatwestudy/niceatm/comptox/ct-opera/opera
Key Takeaway
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * Data used was published and publicly available.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * Major effort was curation—a task AI can now perform much faster.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * Multiple data layers and vendors increased applicability and robustness.
________________


4. ISTAND Program and Metadatapp Fit
Key Question
Does Metadatapp’s infrastructure and data-quality approach fit into ISTAND, or is ISTAND limited to wet-lab models?
Clive’s Input
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * ISTAND is about qualification of data for FDA submissions.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * Once qualified via ISTAND, confidence increases across agencies.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * However:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * Different agencies ask different validation questions.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * Acceptance criteria vary by regulator.
Key Contacts
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * Michael Phelan
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * Previously involved in scrutinizing ISTAND programs.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * Now based in Australia.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * Guest blogger on Clive’s website.
Links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * https://www.linkedin.com/in/michael-phelan-bioe/
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * https://www.ropertcl.com/post/the-fda-istand-program-the-path-to-regulatory-adoption-of-nams
Actions

5. Industrial User Requirements and Regulatory Submissions
Key Question
What industrial user requirements are missing from NAM submissions that lead to FDA/EMA rejection?
Clive’s Assessment
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * Regulatory submissions are highly complex.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * If NAM data is:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * Not central to the submission → it may not even be reviewed.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * Critical (i.e. replacing an existing regulatory test) → scrutiny and importance increase significantly.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * Today:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * It is very hard to prove that a submission was accepted because of a NAM.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * Impact attribution is rarely explicit.
Animal Reduction Perspective
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * Tools from NC3Rs:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * ADE (Animal Design Explorer) calculates the minimum number of animals needed.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * Focus is not reducing animal numbers artificially, but right-sizing studies.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * If Metadatapp can support this process, it can underpin credible reduction claims.
Relevant Links
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * https://3rc.org/mps/
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            * https://eda.nc3rs.org.uk/experimental-design-group
